command.name: security key-manager external azure create-config
command.description: This command creates an Azure Key Vault (AKV) configuration which can be enabled on a Vserver.

parameter.name: name
parameter.description: The DNS name of the deployed AKV .

parameter.name: oauth-host
parameter.description: The hostname of the OAuth server.

parameter.name: authentication-method
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the authentication method.

parameter.name: port
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the port of the deployed AKV.

parameter.name: vault-host
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the AKV vault host.

parameter.name: verify
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify whether to verify the identity of AKV.

parameter.name: verify-host
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify whether to verify the identity of AKV hostname.

parameter.name: verify-ip
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify whether to verify the identity of AKV ip address.

parameter.name: proxy-type
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy type.

parameter.name: proxy-host
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy host.

parameter.name: proxy-port
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy port.

parameter.name: proxy-username
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy username.

parameter.name: proxy-password
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy password.

parameter.name: timeout
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the timeout, in seconds, for attempting to connect to the deployed AKV.

example.p: The example below creates a configuration on a node with the following details: Configuration name: sampleConfig, Client ID: client1, Tenant ID: tenant1, Deployed AKV name: https://samplevault.vault.azure.net, Key ID: https://samplevault.vault.azure.net/keys/key1/keyversion, OAuth Host: https://sampleoauth.net, for Vserver vsTest.
example.screen: cluster-1::> security key-manager external azure create-config -config-name sampleConfig -client-id client1 -tenant-id tenant1 -name https://samplevault.vault.azure.net -key-id https://samplevault.vault.azure.net/keys/key1/keyversion -oauth-host https://sampleoauth.net -vserver vsTest
